incident.what: Registering POST alone on /experimental/worktree reclassified the declared GET and DELETE from NOT-SERVED to METHOD-MISSING, a class TestNotImplementedTableMatchesDeclaredSurfaceArtifact forbids. The full short suite caught it after the first artifact regeneration (the shim package suite alone had been green).
incident.resolution: Served both arms in the same tick (ROUTE-ADD-084 + ROUTE-ADD-083) as a dispatcher extension; the 085 method-guard test was rewritten to assert the undeclared-method guard only. Full suite re-run green; METHOD-MISSING class is now empty.
incident.lesson: A single-method route registration on a multi-operation path changes the drift CLASS of its siblings; never regenerate the artifact before the whole path's declared methods are served.
